I cannot execute system-level commands or modify system files directly. However, I can guide you on how to do it.

2. Run the following command to set the core pattern:
   ```bash
   echo "|/tmp/coredump_handler.sh %e %p" | sudo tee /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern
   ```
3. Then, make the script executable:
   ```bash
   sudo chmod +x /tmp/coredump_handler.sh
   ```
